bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest recent story centers on injury updates ahead of Week 1, as the Bears held wide receiver Rome Odunze out of practice Monday, four days after he left with a right leg injury ahead of Week 1 , while getting better news elsewhere on offense since running backs D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai returned to practice Monday, giving Chicago a major boost ahead of its Week 1 matchup with Carolina . The Bears are now finalizing preparations as the Chicago Bears will open Sunday on the road against the Carolina Panthers to kick off the 2026 regular season.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 1 matchup against the New Orleans Saints at Ford Field, with head coach Dan Campbell providing updates on the roster while safety the team anticipates Thomas Harper will be ready for the season opener . Ahead of the new season, the Lions named seven players captains for 2026, including three first-timers , while injury concerns continue to mount as the roster takes shape for the opener.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers head into their 2026 season opener against the Minnesota Vikings this Sunday at U.S. Bank Stadium with major questions marks, as running back Josh Jacobs remains on the commissioner's exempt list with a suspension looming ahead of his September 10 court date, while star edge rusher Micah Parsons is unlikely to play until Week 5 or Week 6 as he continues rehabbing from a torn ACL .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings signed veteran safety Harrison Smith to a one-year deal worth up to $16 million, reuniting him with the team and giving defensive coordinator Brian Flores added flexibility in the secondary. The Vikings expect Harrison Smith to pursue a Week 1 return against the Green Bay Packers, potentially with a limited workload , as Minnesota looks to kick off its 2026 season with a boost to its defense.
